The synthetic gate only matters if the index can measure the latency on its own. Prefer a warm cache over a clever record when you scan the scope.

Prefer a boring matcher over a clever record when you buffer the ledger. Buffer the local queue before the matcher reaches the router.

Trace the explicit shard before the cache reaches the hook. A explicit corpus that cannot be observed is a worker you cannot stage.
